move: Apple News+ 3D magazine cards fan out, hero card flips 180 degrees, and cards reshuffle in continuous carousel
how: 1920x1080 stage with Apple-style radial ambient light. Clean typography lockup with red badge entrance. Three glossy editorial cards stagger up with 3D Y-axis rotation and shadow depth, followed by an in-place 180-degree flip transition on the hero card and a smooth horizontal carousel reshuffle. Synchronized with Web Audio SFX sweeps and card pops.
adapt: Replace the headlines, brand tags, and card gradients with your product screenshots or magazine covers; adjust card aspect ratio or count in the cards-container.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the 3D card layout and applies shot.cards data; animate(el, shot, D) returns the GSAP timeline scaled to shot duration.
caveats: backface-visibility hidden required for flip card faces
